assertion: Violent crime in Michigan has fallen to its lowest rate in seven years, according to an announcement from Governor Gretchen Whitmer's office.
speaker: Governor's office
warehouse_value: MI violent crime 2025 = 427.2 per 100k, lowest since 2015 (421.2)
sql: SELECT "year", SUM(offense_rate) FROM crime.cde_offenses WHERE state_abbr='MI' AND offense_code='violent-crime' GROUP BY "year"
independent_value: Governor's release Oct 26, 2026 states the same

assertion: Whitmer's office says murders are down 40% since 2021
speaker: Governor's office
sql: SELECT "year", SUM(offense_rate) FROM crime.cde_offenses WHERE state_abbr='MI' AND offense_code='homicide' GROUP BY "year"

assertion: robberies have fallen 50% since she took office
speaker: Governor's office
sql: SELECT "year", SUM(offense_rate) FROM crime.cde_offenses WHERE state_abbr='MI' AND offense_code='robbery' GROUP BY "year"

assertion: Whitmer's office credits a nearly $2 billion investment in public safety since 2018 for the drop in crime.
speaker: Governor's office
warehouse_value: National homicide -38% (6.92 to 4.29, 2021-2025) and national robbery -39% (82.5 to 49.95, 2019-2025); Michigan's declines are only modestly larger
sql: SELECT "year", offense_code, SUM(national_offense_rate) FROM crime.cde_offenses WHERE state_abbr='MI' GROUP BY "year", offense_code
independent_value: Release asserts the credit without causal analysis; Bridge Michigan quotes experts attributing the earlier spike to COVID and calling Michigan's trend close to national

assertion: More than 1,000 illegal guns have been taken off the streets, according to the governor's office.
speaker: Governor's office
reason: No warehouse table carries Operation Safe Neighborhoods seizure counts; only the release and outlets repeating it state the figure.

assertion: Whitmer's office says police departments in Michigan have conducted more than 11,000 check-ins with felony offenders, recovering illegal drugs and weapons as a result.
independent_value: Release: more than 11,000 check-ins; recovered illegal drugs and ammunition (not weapons); WXYZ also says ammunition

assertion: The governor's office also says nearly a third of violent crimes in Michigan involve firearms.
speaker: Governor's office
reason: Warehouse crime tables do not carry weapon type for Michigan violent offenses at a verifiable grain; only the release states it (Bridge Michigan's 2022 reporting said most 2021 violent crimes involved guns, a different year and measure).

assertion: That investment includes grants, social services and a 20% pay raise for Michigan State Police troopers.
independent_value: Release lists revenue-sharing grants, community violence intervention grants, a task force, and a 20% raise for troopers and sergeants; 'social services' is a loose paraphrase

assertion: Tony Gant, director of policy for Safe and Just Michigan, said the same crime numbers reflect a different strategy: greater investment in social services and outreach.
speaker: Tony Gant
reason: Opinion-based causal attribution; searched warehouse crime tables and web for evidence isolating social-service effects and found none.
